title: Exact moment-transfer bounds for entropy
summary: Rational transfer DP plus a globally valid polynomial logarithm bound certifies a local KL estimate on simple paths/cycles.
content: Rational transfer DP plus a globally valid polynomial logarithm bound certifies a local KL estimate on simple paths/cycles. Useful for rigorous probability and analytic inequalities. The later multigraph audit suspended the proposed PPSZ runtime consequence; preserve the local lemma with its domain.
whenToUse: Bounding analytic or probabilistic quantities with exactly computable finite moments.
limitations: The local KL statement is limited to its audited simple-path/cycle domain. Its proposed PPSZ runtime consequence is suspended by the multigraph counterexample.
